turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am intrigued by the gravity of the situation and the potential consequences it may have for European politics.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at my wit's end. The situation is becoming increasingly... complicated.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Come, Your Majesty, let us proceed at once to the facts. I can see that this is no trivial matter, and every moment counts.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I beg of you, gentlemen, to understand the weight of my situation. I am not merely concerned with my own affairs, but with the stability of the empire itself.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am not familiar with the details of your situation. Pray, tell me more about the nature of this complicated affair.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you reveal to me the specifics of this predicament, Your Majesty. The more I know, the better equipped I shall be to unravel the tangled threads of this affair.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that if I reveal too much, it may compromise the delicate balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must confess, Your Majesty, that your words have piqued my interest, and I am eager to learn more about this sensitive matter, but I must also caution that I am merely a humble doctor, and I fear that my limited experience in affairs of state may not be sufficient to handle the weight of your confidences.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am torn between my duty to reveal the truth and the risk of unleashing a calamity upon the continent.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: The truth, Your Majesty, is far more compelling than any risk of calamity. It is my business to uncover secrets, not to conceal them.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of the situation. The fate of my kingdom hangs in the balance, and one misstep could have far-reaching consequences.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: And I must confess, Your Majesty, that your words have only served to heighten my curiosity. Pray, tell me, how may I be of service to you in this matter?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see that you are a man of great delicacy, Your Majesty, but I assure you that the information you possess is far more delicate than your own situation.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am deeply concerned, gentlemen, that you may not fully comprehend the weight of my request. The consequences of this matter are too grave to be taken lightly.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Your Majesty, that you reveal to me the essence of this matter, lest I be forced to deduce it from the faint hints you've thus far provided.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I am intrigued, Your Majesty, by the mention of far-reaching consequences. Might I inquire as to the nature of the kingdom's involvement in this matter?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you reveal the precise nature of the kingdom's involvement, Your Majesty, for it is the only means by which I can hope to grasp the scope of this matter.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I confess, gentlemen, that I am torn between the necessity of secrecy and the imperative of revealing the truth.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I warn you, Your Majesty, that the longer you delay, the more difficult it will be for me to unravel the tangled threads of this case. I require precision and candor, lest I be forced to resort to more...unconventional methods.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I am also curious about the nature of this case and its potential impact on the kingdom's future.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
